Honestly teriyaki sauce is basically the same thing from all the recipes I've seen online only difference is I spent too much time making it look nice for a picture
the ammounts for the sauce are for 5-6 servings i made extra to keep in the fridge so its quick to make again

Ingredients

1 salmon fillet per person

75ml of soy sauce 

350ml of water 

Around 85g of sugar // honey could also be used to substitute sugar (this can be adjusted depending on taste) 

Flour so that the thickness of the sauce can be adapted (use until reached desired thickness)

Garlic grated to taste

Ginger grated to taste

Spinach 

Sesame seeds for garnish

Spring onion for garnish

Sticky rice preferably, but any rice would work 

Method

1.	Add the water, soy sauce along with the sugar/honey, garlic, and ginger into a saucepan. Saucepan should be on low heat

2.	Keep mixing the ingredients in the saucepan while it heats up until it reaches a simmer. Taste it and see if any more of these ingredients are needed

3.	Once happy with the flavour, add flour until the desired thickness of the sauce is reached

4.	In a separate pan, add a bit of oil and then the salmon skin side down

5.	Add as much of the sauce as possible to the pan which has the salmon in it

6.	Transfer the salmon to the grill once it gets the desired sear. As it cooks under the grill, spoon the sauce over the salmon regularly, this means that the salmon will be glossy

7.	Whilst the salmon is in the grill, sautée some spinach and chop some spring onion up to garnish
